assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.people.1: Hush. Some of us clubbed together. A man in a hood is coming for %s. You didn't hear it from me.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.heir.0: The heir's grown tired of waiting for %s to die. Someone may help him along.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.heir.1: A hooded man met the heir by the well last night. Nobody speaks of it. Pray for %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.guild.0: There's a black candle in the tavern window. That's the guild's mark: someone's paid for %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.guild.1: A stranger was counting the guards' steps round the hall. I'd not want to be %s tonight.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.you.0: Psst, %s. A man in a hood was asking after you. Where you sleep, which way you walk.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.you.1: %s, someone's put a price on you. Keep your back to a wall after dark.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.you.2: I saw your name on a scrap of paper in a stranger's hand, %s. Then he burned it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.1: Fine evening. Mind your own business and it'll stay fine.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.2: Looking for someone. Not you. Not yet.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.known: You know that walk: this one's an assassin.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.strikes: An assassin throws off his cloak and stabs %s!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.poisoned: The blade was poisoned! %s is dying. Milk, honey or a golden apple may save him (right-click him with it).
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.parried: %s was warned: he turns the assassin's blade aside and calls his guards!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.parried.says: I knew you'd come! Guards! Seize him!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.purged.says: The physician's draught... I'll live. Find who sent him!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.stabbed: A blade in your side, and a burning in the wound: poison! An assassin!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.warned.says: A blade for me? I'll double the watch. You have my thanks.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.warned: You warn %s of the whispers. He'll be on his guard.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.cured.says: %s... you've saved my life. I won't forget it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.cured: %s gives the antidote to %s, and the poison is beaten.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.survived: Word spreads: %s of %s survived an assassin's blade.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.caught: The assassin sent for %s of %s lies dead.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.caught.by: The assassin sent for %s of %s was cut down by %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.exposed: The assassin's contract bore the seal of %s. %s won't forget it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.murdered.ki: %s of %s has been murdered by an assassin! His heir will be crowned on the morrow.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.murdered.lo: %s of %s has been murdered by an assassin! His heir takes the seat on the morrow.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.riva: In %s they say foreign gold paid for it, but no one can prove whose.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.peop: In %s nobody weeps much. They say his own people paid for it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.heir: In %s they say the heir looks very little like a grieving son.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.guil: In %s a black candle burns in the tavern window. The guild has been paid.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.caught: The assassin is dead. His contract and his purse are yours.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.caught.hi: The assassin is dead. His contract bears the seal of %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.killed: An assassin's blade. Someone paid well for that.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.killed.hi: An assassin's blade, paid for by %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.command.sent: An assassin is on his way.
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.r: Sealed with a foreign crest, scratched out
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.p: Signed with a dozen crosses: his own people
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.h: Sealed with the heir's own ring
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.g: Marked with a black candle: the guild
Sealed with a crest, scratched out
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.r: Marked with a black candle: the guild settles its own
class.jaymoskingdoms.thief.desc: Light blades (daggers, knives, ninjato) hit 25% harder and swing faster. Leather, chain and hide give a point more armour a piece.
class.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.desc: Two-handed weapons (claymores, war axes, glaives, halberds) hit 25% harder. Heavy armour weighs half as much on you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.mage.desc: A wizard's staff casts in your hands, and you learn every scroll you read. Two hearts fewer. A court wizard will teach you how a staff is made, or find one. Pick your first spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.archer.desc: Arrows and bolts hit 25% harder, and you're quicker on your feet. With a bow drawn you jump two blocks and land soft.
class.jaymoskingdoms.survivalist.desc: Hunger drains slower, you drown slower, falls hurt less, a heart more, and a little quicker on your feet.
class.jaymoskingdoms.brute.desc: Maces, flails and axes hit 30% harder; a raised shield stops what gets past other shields, and comes back sooner. Two hearts more. Slower, and heavy armour weighs twice as much on you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.marksman.desc: Guns hit 30% harder, reload and wind up 35% faster, fly half again as far and bend a little toward their mark. Light armour gives a point more a piece. A heart fewer.
class.jaymoskingdoms.sorcerer.desc: Imbue your blade with an element of your own: water, fire, earth, air, lightning or ice. One blow in twenty bursts with it. The element stays on the blade whoever holds it, so you keep one imbued blade at a time. Fewer spells than a Mage, but quicker ones. Pick your element.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fire.desc: Three bolts of fire in a fan.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.arcane.desc: A lance of light at what you're looking at, twice as hard on the undead.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.warding.desc: Absorption for you and the players beside you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.water.desc: Douses, slows, and hurts what fears water.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.ice.desc: Freezes what it hits for a moment.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.class.title: Choose your class
gui.jaymoskingdoms.class.lead: What are you good with? Your pick is for keeps, unless you come by a Writ of Rebirth. Nobody starts with gear: each class shows what it's good with.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.reborn: The writ crumbles. What you were falls away; choose again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ: You've learned nothing I could unmake. But I have a Writ of Rebirth, if you'd be someone else entirely: %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ.sold: %s has no writ for you this week; the ink takes time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ.done: Read it when you're ready. There's no reading it twice.
command.jaymoskingdoms.class.cleared: %s player(s) have no class now; they'll be asked again.
command.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec: Refunded every perk for %s player(s); their levels stay.
command.jaymoskingdoms.skills.reset: Reset the skills of %s player(s) to nothing.
class.jaymoskingdoms.rider.desc: Born to the saddle: your horse runs 15% faster and tires slower under you, horses come to trust you sooner, and you strike 20% harder from horseback. On foot you're a touch slower, bow-legged.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.draining.des: Life drawn from what you're looking at, into you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.raising.desc: A zombie and a skeleton climb out of the ground to fight for you a while.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spell.learned: You learn %s. Sneak and use your staff to turn to it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spell.only: Your staff knows only %s. Read scrolls to learn more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.no_blade: Hold a blade to imbue it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.faded: The element fades from your blade.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.moved: This blade burns with %s now; your last one goes cold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.scroll_beyond: This scroll is beyond a Sorcerer's quick magic.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.mage_staff: A wizard's staff casts in a Mage's hands. Sneak and speak to a court wizard to learn how one is made, or find one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.staff_recip: You learn how a wizard's staff is made: gold and amethyst on two blaze rods. It's in your recipe book.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.staff: A Mage without a staff? I can tell you how one is made. And I have a Writ of Rebirth, if you'd be someone else entirely: %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.staff.done: Gold and amethyst, bound to two rods of blaze. Mind your fingers.
message.jaymoskingdoms.alien.seen: The people of %s saw you change. They know the alien is you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.alien.seen: Saints preserve us... that thing is you?
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.supercell: The sky to the %s turns black, with a sickly green to it. The air has gone very still.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.touchdown.tornad: A tornado has touched down to the %s!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.touchdown.monste: A monstrous tornado has touched down to the %s! Get underground!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.barometer.rain: Barometer: falling. Rain to the %s, %s blocks off.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.barometer.thunde: Barometer: falling fast. A thunderstorm to the %s, %s blocks off.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.barometer.superc: Barometer: plummeting! A great storm to the %s, %s blocks off.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.barometer.over.t: Barometer: very low. A thunderstorm overhead.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.barometer.over.s: Barometer: lower than you've ever seen it. Watch the sky.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.barometer.tornad: Barometer: the needle is spinning! Tornado to the %s, %s blocks off!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.weathervane: The wind is %s, blowing toward the %s.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.overworld: Storms only form in the Overworld.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.sandstorm: A wall of dust is rising to the %s. Sandstorm!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.blizzard: The wind from the %s fills with snow. A blizzard is coming: find a fire or a roof.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.hail: Hailstones are bouncing off the ground to the %s! Cover your head.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.wildfire: Dry lightning! Smoke is rising to the %s: a wildfire, and the wind is driving it.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.flood: The water to the %s is rising. Flood!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.cant.wildfire: Nothing here would burn (or disasters can't break blocks).
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.cant.flood: No river or lake near enough to flood.
death.attack.jaymoskingdoms.hail: %1$s was pelted to death by hail
death.attack.jaymoskingdoms.hail.player: %1$s was pelted to death by hail while fighting %2$s
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.quake.1: The ground trembles under your feet. An earthquake!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.quake.2: The ground heaves and rolls! An earthquake! Get out from under anything that could fall.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.quake.3: The whole land is shaking itself apart! A great earthquake! Get into the open!
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.cant.quake: The ground won't shake just now.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.hail: Hail out of a thunderstorm, %s, within %s hours.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.wildfir: Dry lightning and a wildfire, %s, within %s hours.
disaster.jaymoskingdoms.almanac.fair: The almanac promises fair days ahead.
relief.jaymoskingdoms.paid: The treasury of %s pays %s emeralds for the repairs.
relief.jaymoskingdoms.paid.noble: The ruler of %s opens the treasury: %s emeralds for the repairs, and bread for every door.
relief.jaymoskingdoms.tyrant: The tyrant of %s raises a storm tax of %s emeralds on folk who have just lost everything.
relief.jaymoskingdoms.blamed: The ruler of %s blames the disaster on your unnatural powers. His people won't soon forget it.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.forecast.by: Foretold by the almanacs and the court wizards
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.sandsto: After the sandstorm we've barely a crust between us, and little ones to feed. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.blizzar: After the blizzard we've barely a crust between us, and little ones to feed. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.hail.te: After the hailstorm we've barely a crust between us, and little ones to feed. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.wildfir: After the wildfire we've barely a crust between us, and little ones to feed. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.flood.t: After the flood we've barely a crust between us, and little ones to feed. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.food.quake.t: After the earthquake we've barely a crust between us, and little ones to feed. Could you bring %1$s %2$s? We'll pay what we can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.sands: The sandstorm buried half the town. Dig us out: clear %1$s blocks of sand and wreckage round %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.wildf: The fire left nothing but charred timber and ash. Help us clear %1$s blocks of the ruin round %2$s so we can build again.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.flood: The flood brought down walls and left mud everywhere. Clear %1$s blocks of the mess round %2$s, would you?
quest.jaymoskingdoms.relief.rubble.quake: The earthquake brought the houses down on our heads. Clear %1$s blocks of rubble round %2$s, before anyone else is hurt.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.trespas: Get out of my house! Guards!
Out! You've no business in here!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trespass.warn.0: What are you doing in my house?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trespass.warn.1: I don't know you. Why are you in my home?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.trespass.warn.2: Don't touch anything. I'm watching you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.caught: Aww, you got me! I'm it! One... two... three...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.done: Phew! I'm all tired out. That was the best game ever!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.done.slow: You never caught me! I'm the fastest in the whole village!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.tag.bedtime: Uh oh, it's getting dark. Mum's calling me! Bye!
routine.jaymoskingdoms.water.1: Two buckets for the wash, one for the pot...
routine.jaymoskingdoms.garden.2: These'll bloom by the week's end.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.garden.3: A little more water, I think.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.market.0: Fresh bread! Who's got fresh bread?
routine.jaymoskingdoms.market.1: Did you hear what the smith said?
routine.jaymoskingdoms.market.2: Prices again! Robbery, I tell you.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.chat.1: You'll never guess who I saw by the well.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.stroll.1: The fields look well this year.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.stroll.3: Hm, was that fence always broken?
routine.jaymoskingdoms.fire.1: Tell the one about the creeper again!
routine.jaymoskingdoms.home.2: Now where did I leave my slippers?
routine.jaymoskingdoms.chores.1: Now where did I put the flour?
routine.jaymoskingdoms.read.2: Says here the old king had three wives!
routine.jaymoskingdoms.sweep.2: A clean step, a clean home.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.lunch.3: Don't tell anyone I had two.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.shop.2: I'll take two, if you've got them.
routine.jaymoskingdoms.animals.2: You've grown fat on our turnips!
routine.jaymoskingdoms.watch.2: Look at that gear. An adventurer?
routine.jaymoskingdoms.watch.3: Keep an eye on that one.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.greet.open.3: Lovely day for it, isn't it?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.0: Did you hear about the miller's cart?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.1: Prices at market are getting silly.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.3: The well water tastes funny today.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.4: Someone's been at my turnips again.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.5: Have you seen the new folk by the gate?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.6: I swear the bell rang twice last night.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.open.7: The guards look bored, don't they?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.answer.5: I heard it was worse than that.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.chat.answer.7: Don't let the elder hear you say so.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.0: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get away from the butcher!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.1: I told my wife I'd fix the roof. That was three winters ago.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.2: What's a creeper's favourite food? Ssssalad.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.3: My cow's so lazy she gives powdered milk.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.4: How many builders does it take to mend a wall? Ask again next week.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.5: The blacksmith says he's in a forging mood.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.6: I'd tell you a joke about the mine, but it's too deep.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.open.7: Know what the farmer said to the potato? Nothing. Potatoes can't hear.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.joke.answer.2: Oh, that's dreadful. Tell it again.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.gift.open.0: I saw this and thought of you.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.gift.open.4: Picked this up at market for you.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.gift.open.5: For all your help last week.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.gift.open.6: Don't say I never give you anything.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.meal.open.3: Try this, I baked it myself.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.meal.answer.2: You're a better cook than me.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.hug.open.3: You look like you need a hug.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.hug.open.6: Don't you dare walk past me!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.1: Walk with me to the river later?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.2: I picked these flowers for you.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.3: Every time I see you, I forget what I was doing.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.4: Save me a dance at the fire tonight?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.5: I made you something. It's not very good.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.6: Has anyone told you your eyes are like the sea?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.court.open.7: Can I sit with you at supper?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.affection.open: Thinking of you all morning, dear.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.propose.open.1: I've never been surer of anything. Marry me?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.propose.open.2: Spend the rest of your days with me?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.propose.open.3: I had this ring made. Will you have me?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.propose.open.5: I want to grow old beside you. Will you?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.propose.open.6: I asked the elder. Now I'm asking you.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.propose.answer: Yes! Wait till my mother hears!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.makeup.open.1: I was wrong. There, I said it.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.makeup.open.2: Can we put it behind us?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.makeup.open.3: I've been a fool. Forgive me?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.makeup.open.5: I don't want to fight any more.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.makeup.open.6: I brought you bread. As a peace offering.
I suppose I was wrong too.
All right. Water under the bridge.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.spat.open.0: You still owe me for that pie.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.spat.open.2: Your goat's in my garden again.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.spat.open.7: I heard what you said about my hat.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.snub.answer.7: Excuse me, I have somewhere to be.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.argue.open.1: I know it was you who took my bucket!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.argue.open.2: You let your pigs into my wheat!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.argue.open.4: That fence is a full block onto my land!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.argue.open.7: How dare you show your face!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.argue.answer.4: Say that again, I dare you!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.argue.answer.5: Says the biggest liar in the village!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.shove.answer.5: Who do you think you are?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.fight.open.0: That's it, I've had enough of you!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.fight.lost.2: I'll get you back for this.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.watch.3: My coin's on the tall one!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.guard.4: One more swing and it's the stocks!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.guard.5: Step apart, the pair of you!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.command.nobody: There aren't two grown villagers near you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.0.title: A Lesson for %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.0.text: %1$s has been telling everyone I water my ale. Rough them up for me. %2$s good knocks ought to do it, and don't let the guards see.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.1.title: Settle a Score with %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.1.text: %1$s cheated me at market and laughed about it. I'm no fighter, but you are. Give them %2$s good thumps from me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.2.title: Knock %1$s Down a Peg
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.2.text: Struts about like the king himself, does %1$s. Take them down a peg. %2$s blows, nothing they won't mend from.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.3.title: Payback for %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.beat.3.text: %1$s shoved me in the mud in front of the whole village. I want it paid back, %2$s times over. Quietly.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.0.title: Bring Me %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.0.text: Get %1$s to follow you: tell them you've something to show them. I'll be waiting out by %3$s, %4$s. Leave the rest to me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.1.title: A Quiet Word with %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.1.text: I'd like a quiet word with %1$s, away from prying eyes. Lead them out to %3$s, %4$s. They'd never come if I asked.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.2.title: Lead %1$s Astray
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.2.text: %1$s trusts strangers more than neighbours. Ask them to follow you and bring them out to %3$s, %4$s. I'll be in the bushes.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.3.title: An Ambush for %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.lure.3.text: I've waited long enough. Lure %1$s out to %3$s, %4$s, where no guard will see what happens next.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.grudge_lu: Talk to %s and ask them to follow you. Lead them to %s's hiding spot at %s, %s.
%s is following you. Lead them to %s at %s, %s; don't get too far ahead.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.0: Someone ought to teach %1$s a lesson...
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.1: I'll get %1$s back for that. Somehow.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.2: If only someone would sort %1$s out for me.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.3: Mark my words, %1$s will get what's coming.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.4: I'd pay good emeralds to see %1$s get a thumping.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.6: Is there no one who'll stand up to %1$s?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.7: I need a stranger for this. Someone with fists.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.lure.0: Oh? You've something to show me?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.lure.1: Lead on, then. This had better be good.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.lure.2: A surprise? For me? All right!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.lure.4: I've a little time. Show me.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.lure.6: You seem trustworthy enough. Lead the way.
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.ambush.5: No one to run to now!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.ambush.7: Thought you'd get away with it?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.mercy.1: Who sent you?! Was it them?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.mercy.3: All right! I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.mercy.6: What did I ever do to you?
neighbours.jaymoskingdoms.command.grudge: %s now has a grudge against %s, and work for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.0: Look! Look up! The sky's on fire!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.1: A falling rock... it's coming down this way!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.0: A shooting star! No, it's too big... it's falling!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.1: See it? A star, coming down to earth!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.2: Make a wish... and then run.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.0: Did you feel that? Something came down out there!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.1: It struck the ground! The whole earth shook!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.2: Stay back from where it hit, I beg you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.2: Whoa... when I grow up I'm doing that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.0: Did... did you all see that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.1: That's no trick of the light. That's sorcery.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.2: I'm not drinking at the tavern tonight. I've seen enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.0: They called the wind like a dog to heel!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.1: The air itself is doing what they say!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.2: Hold onto your hats... and your roofs.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.0: Ropes! Out of their wrists! Like a spider!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.1: They swing from the rooftops like it's nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.2: I'll be finding cobwebs on my washing for a week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.1: Things fall UP around that one. I saw it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.2: Don't stand near them, the ground goes heavy.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.1: I blinked and they were somewhere else entirely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.2: There were two of them for a moment. Two!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.0: Blades out of thin air! Out of nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.1: Where are all those weapons coming from?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.2: They've an armoury hidden in the very sky.
Did you hear that hum? My teeth are still ringing.
The air shivers around them like a struck bell.
That sound... it went right through my chest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.0: The shadows moved when they moved.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.1: It went dark around them, in broad day!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.2: Something in the dark answers to that one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.1: That band on their wrist just glowed green... no, it glowed wrong.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.2: They were a person a moment ago. Weren't they?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.1: That thing has teeth everywhere! Get inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.2: Guards! There's a living tar loose in the streets!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.0: A shadow walking on its own! Gods save us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.1: That's no man, that's a shade! Don't look at it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.2: The dark's come for us! Inside, all of you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.0: A monster! A monster in the village!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.1: What in the world is THAT?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.2: Hide the children, something's come out of the sky!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.0: %s isn't themselves! Look at their eyes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.2: That's not %s any more. That black stuff has them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.0: The moon's bleeding. Bar the doors tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.1: Red moon. The dead don't stay down under a red moon.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.2: My grandmother said a moon like that means graves open.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.super_blood: Never seen it so red. Never. Pray.
The whole sky's the colour of a wound...
Get inside. Whatever comes up tonight, it's hungry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.0: Harvest moon! The fields'll be heavy come morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.1: Look how big and golden it is. A good omen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.2: Fine night for it. The crops love a moon like this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.0: A blue moon... they say anything can happen under one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.1: Strange light tonight. Strange things about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.2: The moon's gone cold and blue. I don't like it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.0: A rock fell out of the sky, %s blocks %s of here. Left a hole like a giant's fist.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.1: Did you hear? Fire came down %s blocks to the %s. Scorched earth all round.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.2: Old Edda swears she saw a burning stone fall %s blocks %s of here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.0: A star came down %s blocks %s of here. It's still there, they say, glowing in the crater.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.1: Someone saw a falling star land %s blocks to the %s. Nobody's dared go near.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.2: A star fell %s blocks %s of here. Shepherds say it hums at night.
There's a black thing loose, %s blocks %s of here. It crawls inside people.
Keep off the roads %s blocks to the %s. Something black was seen there, eating.
A living tar, %s blocks %s of here. I'm not making it up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.0: A shadow walked on its own, %s blocks %s of here. A shadow, with nobody casting it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.1: Folk %s blocks to the %s saw a man made of dark. At night, of course.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.2: Something walks as a shade, %s blocks %s of here. Don't go out after dark.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.0: You hear about %s? Does things no one should be able to do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.1: They say %s isn't quite human. The things I've heard...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.2: %s, the strange one. Folk can't stop talking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.win: %s called the wind down on the square, they say. Blew the washing clean off the lines.
They say %s walks on the air. On the AIR.
%s kicked up a storm with one foot. Saw it myself. Nearly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.web: %s swings from the rooftops on ropes from their own wrists. Like a spider.
They say %s spins webs. Big ones. Sticky.
Watch for %s on the rooftops. Web everywhere after.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.gra: %s made the stones float. Picked up a cart with a look, they say.
Things fall up around %s. I wouldn't stand too close.
%s can pull a rock out of the sky. They say.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.chr: %s was in two places at once. Two! I swear on my mother.
Time goes wrong around %s. Clocks don't like them.
They say %s can stop a falling cup in midair, just by wanting to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.ars: %s pulls blades out of thin air. A whole armoury, from nowhere.
They say %s never carries a sword and never lacks one.
Swords rained from the sky around %s. Not one of them was real. All of them cut.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.res: %s hums. Like a bell. The windows shake.
They say %s can shatter a man with a sound.
My cousin heard %s sing once. Still can't hear right.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.dar: %1$s walks with the shadows. They move when %1$s moves.
They say the dark answers %s. Gives me shivers.
Don't cross %s after sundown. The night's on their side.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.xen: %s turns into things. Monsters. With a band on the wrist.
They say %s isn't one creature but many.
I saw %1$s become something with too many eyes. Then become %1$s again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.symbiote.seen: The people of %s saw the symbiote come over you. They know the black thing is you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.symbiote.seen: It just... swallowed them? And they're still in there?
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.seen: The people of %s saw you rise as your shadow. They know the shade is you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shade.seen: They died... and got up as a shadow of themselves. I need to sit down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.3: It's getting bigger! Why is it getting bigger?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.4: Fire in the sky! Somebody ring the bell!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.5: That's no bird. Get the little ones indoors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.3: It's green! Stars aren't meant to be green!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.4: It's leaving a trail like spilt milk across the sky.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.5: My grandfather saw one of those. He was never right after.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.3: Smoke over the trees! That's where it came down!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.4: My pots all fell off the shelf. What WAS that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.5: Don't anybody go poking at it. I mean it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.3: I'm telling everyone! Nobody will believe me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.4: Can you teach me? Please? PLEASE?

talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.web: %s pulled a drowning man out of the river with a web from the bridge.
Every chimney in town has a little web on it now. %s.
They say %s hangs from the clocktower to sleep. Like a bat.
%s strung up three bandits by the ankles, upside down.
My daughter climbs everything since she saw %s.
Spiders follow %s about, they say. Little ones.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.gra: %s stood on the ceiling of the mead hall. For a bet.
They say %s can crush a man just by looking down at him.
Birds fall out of the sky round %s. Gently, mind.
%s held up a collapsing barn while everyone got out.
My scales are wrong since %s passed by.
%s jumped off a cliff and fell up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.chr: %s answered my question before I asked it.
Old Bertram says %s made him young for a moment.
%s was never there and was always there. I don't understand it either.
They say %s has seen tomorrow. Didn't like it.
%s caught an arrow before it was loosed.
My bread rises twice as fast when %s is in town.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.ars: %s carries no blade, yet I saw a hundred.
They say the king's smith wept when he saw %s's swords.
%s duelled six men at once with six swords at once.
Never challenge %s to a fight. Never.
%s summoned a cannon to knock a door down. Could've knocked.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.res: %s sang a note and the bandits dropped their swords.
The church bell rings by itself whenever %s is near.
They say %s can hear your heartbeat from across a field.
%s cracked a boulder with a hum.
My baby stops crying when %s hums. Strangest thing.
%s whistled and every window in the street shattered.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.dar: %s doesn't cast a shadow. Or the shadow doesn't follow them.
They say %s can walk through the dark like a door.
Candles gutter when %s passes. Every time.
My grandmother crossed herself when she saw %s.
%s came back from the dead. As a shadow. Then as themselves again.
The night belongs to %s. Ask anyone who's been out in it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.xen: %s became a dragon. A small one. Still a dragon.
They say %s was a living fire one day and a ghost the next.
%s's band fell from the stars. Folk saw it fall.
Don't play cards with %s. Can't read the face. Faces.
%s turned into a giant and carried a cart up a hill.
Nobody knows what %s really looks like any more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.1: %s's eyes! Look at their eyes, they're red!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.3: That's not %s, not any more! Bar the doors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.4: %s's got teeth like a wolf! Get inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.5: It was %s all along! It was them the whole time!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.7: Don't let %s bite you! Don't let them near!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.8: I knew %s never ate supper with us. I knew it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.10: %s just bit someone! I saw it!
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.turned: You wake with a thirst no water will touch. The light stings your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cure.done: The priest's prayer burns through you, and then it's gone. You're yourself again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.ritual: The fires gutter. Something in the moonlight looks back at you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.moon: The moon holds you. There's no changing back tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.unmaster: The wolf won't come at your call. Not yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.wolfbloo: The fires gutter, but the moon isn't full. Only half the wolf comes into you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.half: Your wolfblood can't change you. Only a full moon could finish the rite.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.den: You come to in the dark, curled in earth that smells of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.turned_ha: You wake with a thirst, but the gold in your blood holds it back. Half of you is still yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.crypt: You wake on cold stone in a crypt you've never seen. It feels like home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.gold: The gold burns going down. Something in your blood fights back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.bloodle: Get your teeth off them, you monster! Guards!
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.vampire.title: The Old Rite: Blood for Blood
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.vampire.text: I see the hunger in you, child; you can't hide it from me. There is an old rite that can still draw it out, but the night must pay for it first. Hunt down %s of the %s that walk among us, and come back to me. Then we'll pray, and you'll be yourself again.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.wolf.title: The Old Rite: The Wolf's Price
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.wolf.text: The moon has its claws in you. I know the rite that can break its hold, but the curse wants a life in return. Slay %s of the %s, one of the cursed in its beast shape, and come back to me. Then the moon will lose its grip on you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bed_rest: You lie down to rest. Poison and withering can't hurt you here.
ship.jaymoskingdoms.too_big: Too many blocks for one ship (the most is %s): is the hull still tied to the land?
ship.jaymoskingdoms.too_long: Too long for one ship (the most is %s blocks): is the hull still tied to the land?
ship.jaymoskingdoms.land: The hull is joined to the land: cut it free first
ship.jaymoskingdoms.not_afloat: The hull must float free on water to cast off
ship.jaymoskingdoms.too_heavy: She's too heavy to float: lighter blocks, or more dry hull
ship.jaymoskingdoms.no_room: No room to drop anchor here
ship.jaymoskingdoms.left_helm: You left the helm: she drifts, sails furling. Take the wheel and sneak once she lies still to drop anchor
ship.jaymoskingdoms.keys.sails: W/S sails  ·  A/D rudder  ·  sneak: anchor
ship.jaymoskingdoms.keys.sails_oars: W/S sails  ·  Space oars  ·  A/D rudder  ·  sneak: anchor
ship.jaymoskingdoms.keys.oars: W/S oars  ·  A/D rudder  ·  sneak: anchor
ship.jaymoskingdoms.keys.paddle: W/S paddle  ·  A/D rudder  ·  sneak: anchor
ship.jaymoskingdoms.no_guns_that_way: No loaded guns on that side
ship.jaymoskingdoms.cannon.loaded: Loaded: touch her off with flint and steel or a fire charge
ship.jaymoskingdoms.cannon.not_loaded: She's not loaded: gunpowder, then round shot
ship.jaymoskingdoms.sinking: She's holed below the waterline and going down!
ship.jaymoskingdoms.finish_frame: Finish her frame first: every frame block wants filling
ship.jaymoskingdoms.built: She's built and her hold bailed: take the helm to cast off
ship.jaymoskingdoms.kit_on_water: Use the kit looking at open water
ship.jaymoskingdoms.kit_no_room: No room for her here: she needs open water ahead of you
ship.jaymoskingdoms.kit_laid: Her frame's laid: fill each frame with what it wants (right-click one to see)
ship.jaymoskingdoms.kit_use: Use on open water to lay her frame ahead of you (in creative she's built whole; sneak for the bare frame)
ship.jaymoskingdoms.plans_blank: Blank: sneak + right-click the helm of a ship you've built (before launch or at anchor) to draw her
ship.jaymoskingdoms.plans_drawn: Drawn: %s blocks. Use the plans on open water to lay her again
ship.jaymoskingdoms.plans_use: A ship of %s blocks. Use on open water to lay her frame (in creative she's built whole; sneak for the bare frame). Kept after use
ship.jaymoskingdoms.plans_fittings: + %s fittings (lanterns, doors...) to put back yourself
sign.jaymoskingdoms.road.title: King's Road
commands.jaymoskingdoms.roads.plan: %s roads still to plan; planning the next
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.overworld: Roads can only be charted in the Overworld
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.begun: Charting from this sign. Follow your road to another sign and mark it with the charter (mark this one again to stop)
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.not_here: Your chart doesn't reach this sign: follow the road right up to it
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.short: Too short to chart: a road must run at least %s blocks
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.off_road: Only %s%% of that was on road (paths, gravel, cobble, bricks, planks): it needs %s%%
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.linked: Road charted: %s blocks. Right-click either sign to travel it
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.put_away: You stopped charting (keep the charter in hand while you go)
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.lost: Your chart lost the road: start again from a sign
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.coach_h: A coach drives you along the road at a gallop. The fare goes to the nearest realm
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.telepor: There after a moment's blackout, worn out as if you'd walked it. The fare is lost to the road
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.too_far: Stand by the milestone to travel from it
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.gone: The sign at the other end is gone, and the road with it
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.rest: You're still worn out from the last road: %s s
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.arrived: You travel the road to %s (%s blocks)
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.no_coac: No coachmen work these parts: there's no realm to send one
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.dismoun: Get down first: the coach can't take you mounted
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.coach_o: A coach takes you along the road to %s (%s emeralds)
language.jaymoskingdoms.foreign: They speak %s, which you don't (%s%% learned). Trade and gestures only.
language.jaymoskingdoms.shrugged: %s shrugs and shakes their head. They speak %s (%s%% learned): trade and gestures only.
language.jaymoskingdoms.fluent: You can speak %s now. Its folk will talk with you.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.gift: They press something into your hands and smile.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.greet: They wave and smile: they know you.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.hungry: They rub their belly and point at your pack: they're hungry.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.bargain: They hold up %s %s and count out %s emeralds on their fingers.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.child: They tag you and run off giggling: you're it!
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.warn: They point at the setting sun, then at the houses: get indoors.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.toll: They hold out a hand and tap it: %s emeralds to pass.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.bout: They raise their fists and flash %s emeralds: a bout, for a wager.
language.jaymoskingdoms.command.unknown: No such tongue (common, northern, southern, wildwood, blossom).
language.jaymoskingdoms.native: You sound born to %s now. Nobody hears an accent any more.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.0: Ha! You try to speak like us? Slow... slow. Good, %s.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.1: You say the words like a little child, %s. Is good! Again!
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.2: No, no, not 'fish'. You just called my mother a fish. Try again.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.3: You learn our words? Brave. Very... brave. Keep going, %s.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.0: You're getting there, %s, though you mangle every other word.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.1: I understood almost half of that. That's an improvement!
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.2: Your grammar's a crime, %s, but the guards won't arrest you for it. Yet.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.3: Not bad! You sound like my grandfather after the harvest ale.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.0: You speak it well now, %s. Where's that accent from? It's charming.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.1: Every word right, but you roll them like a stranger. The children copy you, you know.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.2: I can always tell when it's you, %s. Nobody else here says it like that.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.3: Fluent, yes, but you still sound like you've a mouthful of bread.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.0: Your accent's nearly gone, %s. Only the old folk would notice now.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.1: If I closed my eyes I'd think you grew up two villages over.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.2: There's just a touch of somewhere else when you speak, %s. I'll miss it when it's gone.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.3: You even swear like one of us now. My mother would be appalled.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.native.0: %s, you sound like you were born here. Were you, and nobody told me?
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.native.1: Not a trace of an accent left. You're one of us now, %s.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.native.2: I told my cousin you were a foreigner and he didn't believe me. Well done, %s.
item.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_chart.lore: X marks where she went down. Sail there and look below.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.pirate: The pirate ship %s has gone down, sunk by %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.navy: The warship %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.merchan: The merchantman %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.pir: Sails on the horizon! The pirates of %s are coming ashore at %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_cove.clear: The pirate captain of %s has fallen to %s! The cove's pirates scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_cove.thank: Word of the captain's death spreads along the coast: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.sailing: %s weighs anchor for %s. Sail with her and keep the pirates off her.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.arrived: %s is safe in harbour at %s. Go back to the king for your reward.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.lost: %s has gone down. The escort has failed.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.pirate.title: The Pirates of %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.pirate.text: Pirates out of %1$s burn my coast and take my ships. Their cove is at %2$s, %3$s, and their captain sails from it. Kill him, or send his ship to the bottom with him aboard. Take a ship with guns: he will not come ashore to die.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.escort.title: Safe Passage to %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.escort.text: A merchantman of mine is loaded for %1$s's harbour, at %2$s, %3$s, and the pirates are thick on the water. Come down to my harbour and she'll sail with you. See her safely in.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.escort: Go to %s's harbour: a merchantman sails for %s with you (%s, %s).
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.escorting: Keep the merchantman from %s safe until she reaches %s (%s, %s).
ship.jaymoskingdoms.crew.helm_held: Her captain has the helm. Kill him first.
ship.jaymoskingdoms.crew.hold_guarded: Her crew still guard the hold.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.pirate.cry_4: Take the gold, sink the rest!
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hover: Point at a perk to read it in full; press one to learn it.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.sub.map: The land about you, %s blocks across
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.hover: Point at a row to read it in full.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival: Bells ring in %s: a festival today at the square! All are welcome.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_welcome: The folk of %s welcome you to their festival.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_lords: Only a lord of a realm, or its ruler, can call a festival.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_soon: Your realm held a festival lately; another can be called %s days after it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_war: No festivals while the realm is at war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_cost: A festival costs the treasury %s emeralds, and it hasn't got them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_called_t: %s keeps a festival today (%s emeralds from the treasury).
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_called: %s will keep a festival tomorrow (%s emeralds from the treasury).
festival.jaymoskingdoms.feast.1: A feast fit for the king!
festival.jaymoskingdoms.feast.2: I'll be full till next festival.
festival.jaymoskingdoms.music.2: Request? No? Then I'll play my own.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.0: Well, hello! You're coming home with me.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.1: Look at you! You'll want a name.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.2: Have you no one? You do now.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.3: There's a good beast. Come along.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.cat.1: Don't you dare sit on my bread again.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.cat.3: You've caught another mouse, haven't you.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.dog.2: Yes, yes, I missed you too.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_empty: Hold what you want delivered in your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_far: They're too far away for anyone to take it to them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_nobody: There's nobody about free to run an errand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_refused: The folk of %s won't run errands for you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_lost: Your %s came back to you; the courier couldn't go on.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.missed.1: No sign of them. Back it goes.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.3: Someone ought to bring in food.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.waking.3: Where did I leave my boots?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.raise: Press to put a point in it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.blocked.points: No attribute points left: level a pillar.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.hint: Your character level is Survival, Stealth and Strength added up. Every %s levels earns an attribute point. A respec gives them back with your perks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.legend: Pips: teal from your heritage, gold from your class, white your own. Hearts come from eating well, not from here.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.might.desc: Every blow lands harder, whatever is in your hand.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.endurance.desc: Hunger drains slower, whatever you are doing.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.grit.desc: Tougher hide and a firmer stance: armour, and blows push you back less.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.wits.desc: You learn quicker: every pillar earns more experience. A little luck with loot and fishing too.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.title: Heritage
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.picked: Your heritage, once you choose it. It's for life.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.press: Press it on the left to pick it
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.lead: Your heritage gives free attribute points (see K, Attributes), a gift and a flaw. Your class comes next.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.heartlander.gift: Gift: two attribute points to put where you like
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.heartlander.desc: Plain folk of the river valleys and the farmland. Nothing in your blood marks you out, so you can become anything.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn.desc: Raised under the mountains among picks and lanterns. Stone gives way to you, but you were never built for running.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.gift: Gift: long breath, strong swimming, quick mining under water
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.flaw: Flaw: hunger drains 20% faster when you're dry
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.desc: Sea folk from the coves and reefs. The water is home; dry land wears you down until rain or a swim brings you back.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan.gift: Gift: falls hurt from higher up, and when you sneak, witnesses spot your thieving from less far
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan.desc: Light-footed woodland kin. You drop from branches without a sound, but you were never one for brute force.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.gift: Gift: green skin and antennae; hunger drains 35% slower in the sun
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.flaw: Flaw: fire burns you half again as long
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.desc: Of the Verdant blood, like the folk of the Verdant World. The sun feeds you, and fire is your oldest enemy.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.gift: Gift: fire burns you half as long; hunger drains slower in hot lands
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.flaw: Flaw: hunger drains 25% faster in the cold
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.desc: Born of the badlands, the deserts and the burning places. You shrug off flame, and the frost starves you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.gift: Gift: you never freeze; hunger drains slower in the cold
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.flaw: Flaw: hunger drains 25% faster in hot lands
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.desc: Highlanders of the snowfields and the peaks. Powder snow can't touch you, and the heat wears you thin.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.gift: Gift: in the dark you hit 10% harder and move 5% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.flaw: Flaw: under the open sun you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.desc: Your mother's people kept to the night. You come alive after dusk and in deep places, and the daylight dulls you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.gift: Gift: below half health your blows land 15% harder
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.flaw: Flaw: you start far weaker than anyone (blows 40% lighter, 4 hearts fewer), growing out of it by character level 20; hunger drains 20% faster, always
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.desc: Of an old fighting blood that came down from the stars. You fight hardest when you're losing, and you're never full for long.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.0: You put it out! Bless your hands, %1$s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.1: That would have taken the whole row. Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.2: Quick thinking! I thought we'd lose the roof.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.3: You ran toward the fire. Who does that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.4: Thank you, thank you! My things were all in there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.5: I'll not forget you beat that out for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.6: Look at your hands, you're singed! Thank you, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.7: Fire's out! You've saved more than you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.8: We'd have been sleeping in ashes tonight. Thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.9: There's not many strangers would fight our fire for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.10: You doused it! Somebody fetch them a drink!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.11: My heart's still pounding. Thank you for stopping it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.0: There goes %1$s, who put out our fire!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.1: Ho, %1$s! The roof's still standing, thanks to you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.2: That's the one who ran into the smoke for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.3: %1$s! I still smell the smoke when I see you. In a good way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.5: You're the one who beat the flames out, aren't you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.6: Morning, %1$s. Not a spark since you were last here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.8: The baker says you're welcome at her oven any day, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.9: Every time I see a torch I think of you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.10: There's the one who saved the row from burning!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.11: Hail, %1$s! We'd be living in cinders but for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.hear: You're %1$s? They say you put out a blaze in %2$s.
Word from %2$s is you fought their fire, %1$s.
Are you the one who doused %2$s's fire? Welcome!
%2$s's folk can't stop talking about you, %1$s.
A traveller said you beat out a fire in %2$s. Was it really you?
If our roofs ever catch, we'll know who to send for. %2$s did!
Heard you saved half of %2$s from burning, %1$s.
You're welcome here, %1$s. %2$s speaks well of you.
Ha! The fire-fighter of %2$s, here in our street!
My cousin in %2$s says you ran straight into the smoke.
They say in %2$s you put out what their own couldn't.
%1$s, is it? The one %2$s owes its roofs to?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.0: You saved my life! I... thank you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.1: I thought that was the end of me. Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.2: It had me, it really had me. You came just in time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.3: Thank you! I'll owe you for the rest of my days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.4: You stood between me and that thing. Who are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.5: My legs are still shaking. Thank you, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.6: I'd be dead on the ground if not for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.7: Bless you! I'll tell my children about this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.8: You didn't have to do that. Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.9: I owe you my life, %1$s. Don't think I'll forget.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.10: Gods, that was close. You're a hero, you know that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.11: Thank you! I couldn't run, I just couldn't run.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.0: Did you see that? They cut it down!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.2: They saved them! Right in front of us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.4: Ha! That'll teach it to come here!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.6: I saw it all! The beast never stood a chance!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.7: That's how it's done! Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.9: Someone ring the bell, we've got a hero!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.10: Brave, that one. Brave and quick.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.11: Bless you, %1$s! You saved one of ours!
